Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

In your continual harness, entries created without global_=True belong to this session and are lost with it.

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json, math
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g)
    cnt=np.bincount(a.ravel()); bg=int(cnt.argmax())
    # components 4-conn
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    objs=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if seen[y][x] or g[y][x]==bg: continue
            c=g[y][x]; st=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; cl=[]
            while st:
                cy,cx=st.pop(); cl.append((cy,cx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
            objs.append((c,cl))
    def isL(cl):
        ys={y for y,x in cl}; xs={x for y,x in cl}
        # L = exists corner cell such that all cells in its column-run and row-run
        # check: shape = union of one full vertical segment and one full horizontal segment sharing an endpoint
        from collections import Counter
        colc=Counter(x for y,x in cl); rowc=Counter(y for y,x in cl)
        # vertical bar: column with max run; find corner: cell whose row count==len of horizontal arm etc.
        for (cy,cx) in cl:
            vcol=[y for y in ys if (y,cx) in set(cl)]
            hrow=[x for x in xs if (cy,x) in set(cl)]
            if len(vcol)+len(hrow)-1==len(cl) and set(cl)=={(y,x) for y in vcol for x in []}|{(y,cx) for y in vcol}|{(cy,x) for x in hrow}:
                # check contiguity
                vcol.sort(); hrow.sort()
                if all(vcol[i+1]-vcol[i]==1 for i in range(len(vcol)-1)) and all(hrow[i+1]-hrow[i]==1 for i in range(len(hrow)-1)):
                    if (cy==vcol[0] or cy==vcol[-1]) and (cx==hrow[0] or cx==hrow[-1]):
                        return True
        return False
    from collections import defaultdict
    byc=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs: byc[c].append(cl)
    Ls=[(c,cl) for c,cl in objs if isL(cl) and len(byc[c])==1]
    if not Ls: return g
    tc,Lcl=max(Ls,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    def skey(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cl))
    def mind(A,B): return min(math.dist(p,q) for p in A for q in B)
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs: classes[skey(cl)].append((c,cl))
    cands=[(len(k),k,v) for k,v in classes.items() if len(v)==2 and len(k)>1
           and not (len(v)==2 and v[0][0]==0 and v[1][0]==0)]
    if not cands: return g
    cands.sort(reverse=True)
    top=cands[0][2]
    # farther member from L
    m0,m1=top
    ch = m0 if mind(m0[1],Lcl)>mind(m1[1],Lcl) else m1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for y,x in ch[1]: out[y][x]=tc
    return out

def rule_pred(gi):
    bg,objs=components(gi)
    def isLprop(cl):
        s=set(cl); ys={y for y,x in cl}; xs={x for y,x in cl}
        for (cy,cx) in cl:
            vcol=sorted(y for y in ys if (y,cx) in s); hrow=sorted(x for x in xs if (cy,x) in s)
            if len(vcol)>=2 and len(hrow)>=2 and len(vcol)+len(hrow)-1==len(cl) and {(y,cx) for y in vcol}|{(cy,x) for x in hrow}==s:
                if all(vcol[i+1]-vcol[i]==1 for i in range(len(vcol)-1)) and all(hrow[i+1]-hrow[i]==1 for i in range(len(hrow)-1)):
                    if (cy in (vcol[0],vcol[-1])) and (cx in (hrow[0],hrow[-1])): return True
        return False
    L=max((cl for c,cl in objs if isLprop(cl)),key=len); Lset=set(L); Lcol=gi[L[0][0]][L[0][1]]
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs: classes[skey(cl)].append((c,cl))
    def dmn(cl): return min(abs(py-y)+abs(px-x) for py,px in Lset for y,x in cl)
    cands=[v for v in classes.values() if len(v)==2 and len(next(iter(classes.keys() if False else v[0][1])))>1]
    cands=[v for v in classes.values() if len(v)==2 and len(v[0][1])>1]
    sel=[v for v in cands if min(dmn(cl) for c,cl in v)==2]
    if not sel: return None
    v=max(sel,key=lambda v:len(v[0][1]))
    (c0,a),(c1,b)=v
    far=a if dmn(a)>dmn(b) else b
    return Lcol, far
ok=True
for idx,(gi,go) in enumerate([(p['input'],p['output']) for p in pairs]+[(demo1_in,demo1_out),(demo2,demo2_out)]):

    pred=set(r[1]) if r else set()
    st='OK' if pred==changed else 'BAD'
    if st=='BAD': ok=False
    print(idx,st, r[0] if r else None)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'rule incomplete')

def rule_side(gi):
    corner,vdir,hdir,vtip,htip,vl,hl=Lgeom(gi)
    bg,objs=components(gi)
    Lcl=max(findLs(gi),key=lambda t:len(t[1]))[1]; Lset=set(Lcl)
    concave_above = (vdir=='down')  # arms extend down => opening/concave side is above horizontal arm row
    # twin classes by skey
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl2 in objs:
        if set(cl2)==Lset: continue
        classes[skey(cl2)].append((c,cl2))
    cands=[]
    for k2,mem in classes.items():
        if len(mem)<2: continue
        for c,cl2 in mem:
            above = any(y<corner[0] for y,x in cl2)
            if (above and concave_above) or (not above and not concave_above):
                cands.append((c,cl2))
    if not cands: return None
    mx=max(len(cl2) for c,cl2 in cands)
    top=[(c,cl2) for c,cl2 in cands if len(cl2)==mx]
    if len(top)!=1: return ('AMB',[ (c,len(cl2)) for c,cl2 in top])
    c,cl2=top[0]
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for y,x in cl2: g[y][x]=0
    return g

    Lcl=max(findLs(gii),key=lambda t:len(t[1]))[1]; Lset=set(Lcl); Lc=gii[Lcl[0][0]][Lcl[0][1]]

    print('==',lbl,'corner',corner,'vdir',vdir,'hdir',hdir,'Lsize',len(Lcl),'Lcolor',Lc)
    for c,cl2 in objs:
        if set(cl2)==Lset: continue
        mark='CHG' if set(cl2)&chg else '   '
        cells=[tuple(t) for t in cl2]
        same=[cl3 for c3,cl3 in objs if set(map(tuple,cl3))!=set(cells) and skey(cl3)==skey(cl2)]
        y=min(p[0] for p in cells); x=min(p[1] for p in cells)

def rule8(gi):
    corner,vdir,hdir,vtip,htip,vl,hl=Lgeom(gi)
    bg,objs=components(gi)
    Lcl=max(findLs(gi),key=lambda t:len(t[1]))[1]; Lset=set(map(tuple,Lcl)); Lc=gi[Lcl[0][0]][Lcl[0][1]]
    nonL=[(c,cl2) for c,cl2 in objs if set(map(tuple,cl2))!=Lset]
    szm=[(c,cl2) for c,cl2 in nonL if len(cl2)==len(Lcl)]
    if len(szm)==1:
        c,cl2=szm[0]; out=[r[:] for r in gi]
        for y,x in cl2: out[y][x]=Lc
        return out
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl2 in nonL: classes[skey(cl2)].append((c,cl2))
    def dL(cl2): return min(abs(y2-y)+abs(x2-x) for y2,x2 in Lcl for y,x in cl2)
    def pick(cands):  # cands: list of cl2
        cands.sort(key=dL)
        out=[r[:] for r in gi]
        for y,x in cands[0]: out[y][x]=Lc
        return out
    prim=[]; fb=[]
    oppv=-1 if vdir=='down' else 1
    opph=-1 if hdir=='right' else 1  # opposite-hdir side sign for x
    for sk3,mem in classes.items():
        if len(mem)!=2: continue
        (c1,a),(c2,b)=mem
        def sides(cl2):
            aa=any(y<corner[0] for y,x in cl2); ab=any(y>corner[0] for y,x in cl2)
            al=any(x<corner[1] for y,x in cl2); ar=any(x>corner[1] for y,x in cl2)
            return aa,ab,al,ar
        aa,ab,al,ar=sides(a); ba,bb,bl,br=sides(b)
        # primary: straddle horizontal row
        if (aa and bb) or (ab and ba):
            for c,cl2 in mem:
                other=b if cl2 is a else a
                oa,ob,ol,or_=sides(other)
                candv = all(y<corner[0] for y,x in cl2) if oppv<0 else all(y>corner[0] for y,x in cl2)
                twinopp = (all(x>corner[1] for y,x in other) if opph>0 else all(x<corner[1] for y,x in other))
                twinvs = (all(y<corner[0] for y,x in other) if oppv>0 else all(y>corner[0] for y,x in other))
                if candv and twinopp and twinvs: prim.append(cl2)
        # fallback: straddle vertical col
        if (al and br) or (ar and bl):
            side = 1 if hdir=='right' else -1
            for c,cl2 in mem:
                other=b if cl2 is a else a
                candh = all(x>corner[1] for y,x in cl2) if side>0 else all(x<corner[1] for y,x in cl2)
                twinopp2 = (all(x<corner[1] for y,x in other) if side>0 else all(x>corner[1] for y,x in other))
                if candh and twinopp2: fb.append(cl2)
    if prim: return pick(prim)
    if fb: return pick(fb)
    return 'NOCAND'

helpers='''
from collections import defaultdict

def components(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*C for _ in range(R)]; objs=[]
    for y in range(R):
        for x in range(C):
            if not seen[y][x]:
                col=g[y][x]; stack=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; cl=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cl.append((a,b))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=a+dy,b+dx
                        if 0<=ny<R and 0<=nx<C and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==col:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
                objs.append((col,cl))
    return g[0][0],objs

def skey(cl):
    ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
    n=sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cl)
    return tuple(n)

def findLs(g):
    bg,objs=components(g); res=[]
    for c,cl in objs:
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        h=len(xs)>0 and all(y==ys[0] for y,x in cl)
        v=len(xs)>0 and all(x==xs[0] for y,x in cl)
        if h or v:
            res.append((c,cl,(ys[0],xs[0]) if h else (ys[0],xs[0])))
    return res

def Lgeom(g):
    bg,objs=components(g)
    Lcl=max(objs,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))[1]
    ys=[y for y,x in Lcl]; xs=[x for y,x in Lcl]
    corner=(ys[0],xs[0])
    vdir='down' if max(ys)>corner[0] else 'up'
    hdir='right' if max(xs)>corner[1] else 'left'
    return corner,vdir,hdir,None,None,None,None
'''

def cands_of(gi):
    LsA=findLs(gi); anchor=max(LsA,key=lambda t:len(t[1])); ac,acells,(acy,acx)=anchor
    bg,objs=components(gi)
    anset=set(map(tuple,acells))
    nonA=[(c,cl) for c,cl in objs if set(map(tuple,cl))!=anset and c!=bg]
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in nonA: classes[skey(cl)].append((c,cl))
    vd='down' if any(y>acy for y,x in acells) else 'up'
    hd='right' if any(x>acx for y,x in acells) else 'left'
    out=[]
    for sk,mem in classes.items():
        if len(mem)!=2: continue
        for i,(c,cl) in enumerate(mem):
            oc,ocl=mem[1-i]
            above=any(y<acy for y,x in cl); below=any(y>acy for y,x in cl)
            left=any(x<acx for y,x in cl); right=any(x>acx for y,x in cl)
            oabove=any(y<acy for y,x in ocl); obelow=any(y>acy for y,x in ocl)
            oleft=any(x<acx for y,x in ocl); oright=any(x>acx for y,x in ocl)
            diag=((above if vd=='down' else below) and (left if hd=='right' else right))
            otherside=(obelow if vd=='down' else oabove)
            twinquad = (oabove if vd=='down' else obelow) and (oleft if hd=='right' else oright)
            if diag: out.append((c,len(cl),sk, 'otherside_ok' if otherside else 'twin_same_quadrant_or_span', 'twinquad' if twinquad else ''))
    return (ac,(acy,acx),vd,hd), out
for lbl in ['k4','k5','d3','d4','d7']:
    gi,goo=dict(alld14)[lbl]
    a,cs=cands_of(gi)
    # truth
    diff={(y,x) for y in range(len(gi)) for x in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[y][x]!=goo[y][x]}
    bg,objs=components(gi)
    tc=[(c,len(cl),str(skey(cl))[:30]) for c,cl in objs if set(map(tuple,cl))&diff]
    print(lbl,'anchor',a,'cands:',cs,'| truth:',tc)

        c,cl2=szm[0]; out=[r[:] for r in gi]
        for y,x in cl2: out[y][x]=Lc

    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl2 in nonL: classes[skey(cl2)].append((c,cl2))
    def dL(cl2): return min(abs(y2-y)+abs(x2-x) for y2,x2 in Lcl for y,x in cl2)
    def pick(cands):  # cands: list of cl2

    prim=[]; fb=[]
    oppv=-1 if vdir=='down' else 1

    for sk3,mem in classes.items():

        def sides(cl2):

                oa,ob,ol,or_=sides(other)

                twinopp = (all(x>corner[1] for y,x in other) if opph>0 else all(x<corner[1] for y,x in other))

def ray(gi, acor, acell, axis, back=True):

    y,x=y0+dy,x0+dx; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); Ls_=set(map(tuple,acell))
    while 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W:

steps.input:
def R7(gii): # second-largest L (not anchor), diagonal-opposite quadrant, nearest object
    Ls_=sorted(findLs(gii),key=lambda t:-len(t[1]))
    if len(Ls_)<2: return None,'no2nd'
    # anchor = largest; second = next
    s=Ls_[1]; acell,acor=s[1],s[2]; ey,ex=acor
    vd='down' if any(y>ey for y,x in acell) else 'up'
    hd='right' if any(x>ex for y,x in acell) else 'left'
    bg,objs=components(gii)
    cands=[]
    for c,cl in objs:
        if c==bg or set(map(tuple,cl))==set(map(tuple,acell)) or set(map(tuple,cl))==set(map(tuple,s[1])): continue
        opv=(max(y for y,x in cl)<ey) if vd=='down' else (min(y for y,x in cl)>ey)
        oph=(min(x for y,x in cl)>ex) if hd=='right' else (max(x for y,x in cl)<ex)
        if opv and oph: cands.append(cl)
    if not cands: return None,'nocand'
    return min(cands,key=lambda cl: min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in cl)),(vd,hd,acor)
ok=0; notes=[]
for lbl,(gii,goo) in alld15:
    p,note=R7(gii)
    diffc={(y,x) for y in range(len(gii)) for x in range(len(gii[0])) if gii[y][x]!=goo[y][x]}
    hit = p is not None and diffc<=set(map(tuple,p))
    ok+=hit; notes.append((lbl,hit,note,None if p is None else (len(p),sorted(p)[:3])))
print(ok, notes)

def feats_correct(gii):
    Ls_=findLs(gii); anch=max(Ls_,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    acell,acor=anch[1],anch[2]; ey,ex=acor
    vd='down' if any(y>ey for y,x in acell) else 'up'
    hd='right' if any(x>ex for y,x in acell) else 'left'
    bg,objs=components(gii)
    nonL=[cl for c,cl in objs if c!=bg and set(map(tuple,cl))!=set(map(tuple,acell))]
    skc=Ct(skey(cl) for cl in nonL); zc=Ct(len(cl) for cl in nonL)
    out={}
    for cl in nonL:
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        opv = (min(ys)>ey) if vd=='up' else (max(ys)<ey)
        oph = (min(xs)>ex) if hd=='left' else (max(xs)<ex)
        f={}
        f['opv']=opv; f['oph']=oph
        f['samev']=not opv; f['sameh']=not oph
        f['tw_skey']=skc[skey(cl)]>=2
        f['tw_cz']=zc[len(cl)]>=2 and True
        f['tw_size']=zc[len(cl)]>=2
        f['size1']=len(cl)==1
        f['dmin']=min(abs(y-ey)+abs(x-ex) for y,x in cl)
        out[id(cl)]=(cl,f)
    return out

                    # nearest/farthest to anchor corner

src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    def comps(gg):
        bg=gg[0][0]
        seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
        for y in range(H):
            for x in range(W):
                if not seen[y][x]:
                    c=gg[y][x]; st=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; cl=[]
                    while st:
                        a,b=st.pop(); cl.append((a,b))
                        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            ny,nx=a+dy,b+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and gg[ny][nx]==c:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                    objs.append((c,cl))
        return bg,objs
    bg,objs=comps(g)
    def isL(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        h,w=max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        if len(cl)!=h+w-1: return False
        corners=[(min(ys),min(xs)),(min(ys),max(xs)),(max(ys),min(xs)),(max(ys),max(xs))]
        for cy,cx in corners:
            cells=set(cl)
            arm1=[(y,cx) for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]
            arm2=[(cy,x) for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)]
            if cells==set(arm1)|set(arm2): return True,(cy,cx)
        return False
    Ls=[(len(cl),cl) for c,cl in objs if c!=bg and isL(cl)]
    if not Ls: return g
    Ls.sort(key=lambda t:-t[0])
    asz,acl=Ls[0]
    ys=[y for y,x in acl]; xs=[x for y,x in acl]
    ey,ex=(min(ys)+max(ys))//2,(min(xs)+max(xs))//2
    vd='down' if any(y>ey for y,x in acl) else 'up'
    hd='right' if any(x>ex for y,x in acl) else 'left'
    acol=g[acl[0][0]][acl[0][1]]
    # opposite-vertical half-plane, exclude anchor & other Ls
    otherL=set(map(tuple,acl))
    for _,l2 in Ls[1:]: otherL|=set(map(tuple,l2))
    cand=[]
    for c,cl in objs:
        if c==bg: continue
        cl2=[t for t in cl if t not in otherL]
        if len(cl2)!=len(cl): continue
        oys=[y for y,x in cl]
        opp_v = (max(oys)<ey) if vd=='down' else (min(oys)>ey)
        if opp_v: cand.append((len(cl),cl))
    if not cand: return g
    cand.sort(key=lambda t:-t[0])
    tgt=cand[0][1]
    for y,x in tgt: g[y][x]=acol
    return g
'''
